rationale: Despite strong post-earnings buying pressure on 10.85x relative volume, the stock is currently trading at 100% of its intraday range ($12.24) and is extended roughly 2.5 ATRs above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($11.83) and 4.5 ATRs above VWAP ($11.50).
